info.title: Plug JSON-RPC contract
info.description: Canonical tagged JSON-RPC v1 contract snapshot for Plug. Go and OpenRPC share the operation, event, cursor, and error encodings; source provenance and an independently checked method registry are recorded in this document.

methods.name: session.open
methods.summary: Open a live collaboration session.
methods.description: Open a caller-owned live collaboration session. Its idle expiry is bounded to five minutes after opening or the latest successful presence.set. Disconnects are reclaimed by expiry; one-shot CLI calls open no session. After reconnect or failover, open a new session and recreate watches using their last acknowledged cursors. Existing cursor expiry, reset and incarnation-gap rules apply. Optional displayName follows x-display-name-contract; omitting it preserves existing session behavior.

params.name: displayName
params.description: Optional caller-asserted, untrusted display-only label. Trim leading and trailing Unicode White_Space; reject Unicode control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters with typed invalid_params. Allow at most 64 Unicode scalar values after trimming, not bytes or grapheme clusters; empty after trimming means absent. The raw input schema intentionally has no maxLength because padding is removed before applying the bound. Normalization and category rejection require the later consumer; schema validation alone does not perform them. Never use displayName for authorization, attribution, audit actor, idempotency, leases or dedup. Render it next to the authenticated principal (user name, API key name, or anonymous), never instead of or as that principal.

params.name: _meta
params.description: Transport metadata; not an application actor field.

methods.name: session.close
methods.summary: Close a live collaboration session.
methods.description: Close the caller-owned session and release its presence, watches and watch quota. An unknown, expired, already closed or unreadable session returns not_found. Session closure changes only ephemeral collaboration state and returns no changeset or revision.

Unknown, expired, closed or unreadable sessions return not_found; a disconnected client must session.open again and resume watches from their last acknowledged cursors.

methods.name: view.run
methods.summary: Run a saved or inline budgeted view.
methods.description: With countOnly=true, return the exact ordinary authorized predicate total, including zero, as {items:[],asOf,count}, plus existing projection metadata. No page, groups, elisions or nextCursor is returned; cursor/groupBy combinations refuse invalid_params. Valid fields/sort/budget cannot change or truncate membership. Historical content uses current authorization; more than 20,000 authorized candidates refuses scope_too_large. Absent/false keeps existing behavior and saved definitions unchanged. Run a saved or inline budgeted view. A trusted host may enable count-only parent-aware epic progress using definition={filter:{query:"parent=<bare bead ID>"},fields:[],groupBy:["epic-progress"]} and _meta.project equal to the authorized parent project. One pinned content/ontology snapshot and fenced current authority select direct children only; each child keeps its own project permissions. The complete result has items=[], asOf, total and status:<canonical status ID> groups with empty items. total.count is visible children; only total.elided may report hidden children, as count plus reason="authorization" and continueWith=view.run with the same request minus cursor/asOf. That is fresh reauthorization/refresh, never hidden-row pagination. There is no nextCursor; a supplied cursor refuses cursor_invalid. Hidden identities/statuses are absent. Disabled capability refuses invalid_params with details.capability="epic-progress", details.available=false. Epic progress adds no separate RPC, filter, cursor or result member. Read-only age/status selection for view.run. days is a positive UTC day count; the latest persisted version time must be strictly before one cutoff bound to the signed cursor for all pages. Omitted status selects the current ontology Unstarted/Started categories; an explicit exact status replaces that default and intersects with ordinary query predicates. No saved definition, ready, claimNext, watch or explain semantics change.

params.name: countOnly
params.description: Optional execution flag, default false; saved definitions are unchanged. True returns the complete authorized ordinary predicate count with items=[] and asOf, without groups, elisions or nextCursor. Any supplied cursor or nonempty groupBy refuses invalid_params. Valid fields, sort and budget remain validated but do not change membership or truncate the count. Current permissions apply to historical asOf content; the ordinary 20,000 cap is exact-or-refused.

params.name: stale
params.description: Read-only age/status selection for view.run. days is a positive UTC day count; the latest persisted version time must be strictly before one cutoff bound to the signed cursor for all pages. Omitted status selects the current ontology Unstarted/Started categories; an explicit exact status replaces that default and intersects with ordinary query predicates. No saved definition, ready, claimNext, watch or explain semantics change.

methods.name: bead.cycles
methods.summary: Report deterministic current durable-plane dependency cycles.
methods.description: Default follows blocks and conditional-blocks only. Optional tracks retains the default report and adds a shortest-return cycle per blocking edge. Parent-child and waits-for are excluded. A visible project member anchors each item; hidden members retain placeholders. includeEphemeral=true requires the durable workflow capability; memory returns plugin_durable_state_unavailable, while SQLite/PostgreSQL expose live workflow items through the standard ready/read tools. Workflow auxiliary edges are read through the typed workflow item and mixed-plane bridge.

params.name: includeTracks
params.description: Add the canonical mixed report; pure tracks loops are excluded.

params.name: includeEphemeral
params.description: True includes live workflow items only when a durable workflow capability is installed; memory returns plugin_durable_state_unavailable. SQLite and PostgreSQL expose their typed workflow relations through the workflow read bridge.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum returned items, default100; cycleCount remains the complete visible-project count.

params.description: Transport project scope and deadlines; no application actor field.

methods.name: gate.list
methods.summary: List exact installed gates in canonical default query order.
methods.description: Includes templates, pinned-status and ephemeral gates by default. All includes closed gates alongside open gates. Exclude templates before the selected gate limit; limit zero is unlimited. Merge both planes and order by priority ascending, creation time descending, then ID ascending before the limit. Await type filtering follows that limit: empty or all matches every type, gh matches gh: prefixes, other values match exactly. Query failures propagate; missing issue rows are dropped.

Meta.description: Per-call transport metadata. Identity is never accepted here.

project.description: Project scope; defaults from the principal or server.

idempotencyKey.description: At least 128 bits of caller or SDK randomness for writes.

agent.description: Unverified client label used only to scope anonymous leases and idempotency.

Ref.description: Canonical wire reference. Exactly one of id or key is present; branch is valid only with id.

Filter.description: Parent selects transitive descendants for ready and direct children for the snapshot list, before pagination. The separate opt-in epic-progress view uses exactly query=parent=<bare branch-zero bead ID> with no additional query clauses, resources, types or events; it selects canonical direct children only, across their own projects.

parent.description: Transitive descendants of this branch-zero bead ID, excluding the root; applied before pagination.

priority.description: Exact priority intersected with the other membership filters before pagination.

viewId.description: View membership for subscriptions and watches.

includeEphemeral.description: Include live ephemeral workflow items; defaults to true for backward-compatible ready reads.

parent.description: Canonical direct parent ID when readable; an unreadable parent is exactly {exists:true} with no identity, project, status or content. Root beads omit parent. Requests and storage retain canonical Ref values.

targetStatus.description: Exact declared nonterminal status for this project/type; omission selects the workflow initial status. Noninitial targets require an allowed transition from initial and all its guards. Terminal loading uses create followed by guarded close.

metadata.description: Typed predicates apply only to waits-for; opaque nativeExtensions apply to every kind. Omission preserves existing metadata on re-add; explicit {} selects all-children without also_blocks.

comments.description: Optional imported or legacy comments. Existing bead.get authorization and as-of semantics apply.

ViewDefinition.description: The trusted epic-progress capability admits groupBy=["epic-progress"], explicitly present fields=[], and exactly filter.query="parent=<bare bead ID>". No sort or additional filters are admitted. budgetTokens must be absent or zero: this complete count is not token-budgeted or paged. The ordinary authorized input cap is 20,000, never the 100,000 type-summary exception; at most 100 groups including total are returned. Refusals return no partial counts.

elided.description: An output bound. Epic progress reports hidden direct children only on the total group: count is the exact hidden remainder and reason is authorization. Render the literal “N more you can’t see”; never infer hidden statuses. Its required continueWith refreshes the same authorized request without cursor/asOf and cannot reveal or page hidden children. Ordinary output_budget elision retains its signed continuation semantics.

groups.description: Existing grouped output. Epic progress returns key=total with the visible direct-child count and status:<canonical status ID> groups counting visible children only; every items array is empty. Keys identify statuses in the ontology read from the same asOf content snapshot; they do not infer labels, readiness or completion policy. Only total may carry authorization elision. MaxGroups=100 includes total; incomplete or over-limit results refuse without truncation.

count.description: Exact authorized ordinary predicate total, present including zero only for countOnly=true. Items is empty; groups, elisions and nextCursor are absent. The ordinary 20,000 authorized-candidate cap applies; overflow refuses scope_too_large without a partial count.

Changeset.x-event-order: Absent events means legacy ChangeRecord indexes. Present events is the complete atomic plan. No partial plans, empty plans, synthetic dependent changes, or truncation. Public resume tuple remains incarnation/revision/index; projections consume the complete revision.

HumanPresence.description: D32 proof bound to the method and plan/archive digest. API keys and iframe or other-origin bearer calls cannot satisfy interactive_session.

WarningCode.description: Closed subset of error codes permitted in result.warnings.

StoreRestoredDetails.description: Restore crossed the incarnation boundary; the envelope carries the new incarnation.

ConditionUnmetDetails.x-validation: Refs must match the directed edge; edge revision equals dependent image revision; blocker before/after refs match and revisions differ; status changes. Resolved decisions use the pinned blocker-own-project ontology, never live interpretation. Blocker-after must be strictly later than blocker-before; dependent and ontology source revisions cannot be later than blocker-after.

DependencyConditionUnmetEvent.x-validation: resource is bead/<dependent ID>; revision equals blockerAfter.revision. No mutation of the dependent is implied. Current read authorization and redaction cover dependent, blocker, ontology and optional blocker project; suppress the entire notice on any denial.

EventDescriptor.x-validation: Index equals array position. Exactly one ordinary event for every ChangeRecord in ChangeIndex order, followed immediately by notices sorted uniquely by dependent ID. Notices retain ordinary close/cancel slot event and identical provenance, anchor the changed blocker and from/current revisions. Chain matches the changeset header. Event/resource kind, operation and slot must agree.

DisplayNameInput.description: Optional caller-asserted, untrusted display-only label. Trim leading and trailing Unicode White_Space; reject Unicode control (Cc) and format (Cf) characters with typed invalid_params. Allow at most 64 Unicode scalar values after trimming, not bytes or grapheme clusters; empty after trimming means absent. The raw input schema intentionally has no maxLength because padding is removed before applying the bound. Normalization and category rejection require the later consumer; schema validation alone does not perform them. Never use displayName for authorization, attribution, audit actor, idempotency, leases or dedup. Render it next to the authenticated principal (user name, API key name, or anonymous), never instead of or as that principal.

DisplayName.description: Optional normalized, untrusted display-only label from session.open. Omit when empty after trimming Unicode White_Space; otherwise 1..64 Unicode scalar values, with no control (Cc) or format (Cf) characters. Trimming and category rejection are normative consumer requirements. Never use it for authorization, attribution, audit actor, idempotency, leases or dedup. Always render it next to the authenticated principal (user name, API key name, or anonymous); never replace or impersonate the principal. Keep two sessions of one principal as distinct members by sessionId, each with its own displayName; do not merge their labels into a trusted group identity.

Comment.description: Stored comment. Legacy comments retain body, principal and time. Imported comments add a verified restoring principal, fixed import origin, restore commit time and separate source provenance.

id.description: Stable one-based position in the append-only stored thread.

CommentPageSelection.description: Select one comment page. The default limit is 100 and the maximum is 500; a cursor resumes the pinned thread.

CommentPage.description: One pinned comment thread page in (time, stored ordinal) order. An absent nextCursor marks the end.

LegacyComment.description: Pre-import stored comment shape. It is decoded unchanged for backward compatibility.

principal.description: Verified restoring actor supplied by the trusted import admission; never sourceAuthor.

time.description: Restore commit time, not the source comment time.

sourceTime.description: Original source timestamp retained as untrusted provenance.

ImportedComment.description: Verified imported comment. origin is fixed to import; sourceAuthor is optional untrusted provenance and cannot identify an actor.

CommentOrigin.description: The only trusted origin for the imported comment shape.

SourceAuthor.description: Normalized untrusted source author provenance: trim Unicode White_Space, reject Unicode Cc and Cf controls, and count at most 256 Unicode scalar values. Empty after trimming is omitted.

hash_namespaces.description: Sorted exact source namespace inventory; each namespace is separate from the root hash token.

SourceAllocatorProvenance.description: Immutable source allocator declaration retained exactly as provenance in the restore receipt and project metadata key plug.restore.sourceAllocator. Hash declarations accept hash_length 1..64; sequential declarations preserve hash_length 0..64. It is never interpreted as the live target allocator.

TargetRandomAllocator.description: Explicit live Plug allocator. A 16-byte candidate is rendered as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; top-level IDs are prefix-random and direct child IDs are parent-random.

RestoreAllocatorProfile.description: The source provenance and live target allocator are separate values and are persisted/recovered together. targetAllocator.prefix must equal sourceAllocator.prefix; a mismatch refuses before staging.

scope.description: Normalized G4 AgentLabel is empty for authenticated actors.
Normalized G4 AgentLabel for anonymous-local mode; empty is allowed.

RestoreImportAdmission.description: Host-private trusted admission. Authenticated mode binds an interactive user, restore-admin authorization and operation/archive D32; anonymous-local mode records trusted human presence and an honest anonymous actor/agent scope. A JSON principal, archive field, lease or digest cannot mint this admission.

historyMode.description: Archive history policy. Omitted input is strict full history; partial and snapshot are explicit opt-ins.

RestoreImportProfile.description: Transaction-local prepared import profile. The trusted host creates it after admission; ordinary JSON-RPC callers cannot submit or forge it.

CloseOp.description: Enter the close slot or an explicit declared successful terminal status at this operation position in tx.apply; reuse bead.close guards, permission, reason and provenance. Any refusal rolls back the whole ChangeSet. No force or generic status shortcut.

expect.description: Preconditions against the ordered in-request image before this close. Revision guards refuse a record written earlier in this request. ChangeSet.expect keeps its pinned-snapshot semantics.

targetStatus.description: Exact declared successful terminal status for this project/type; omission selects the close slot. All transition, permission, graph and child guards remain in force. Active workflow providers that cannot honor the selector refuse it.

nativeExtensions.description: Opaque native field JSON token text, preserved byte-exact. Absent keys retain prior values; null is the token string null. These values have no scheduling or thread semantics.

CycleMember.description: One member in directed cycle order; an unreadable member discloses no reference.

Cycle.description: A path rotated to its lowest internal ID; the closing endpoint is implied.

CyclesResult.description: Current durable-plane cycles anchored by a readable member in the selected project. Wholly hidden cycles contribute no items or count.

LinkTargetKind.description: Omission is local. Explicit external targets retain an exact nonempty branch-zero ID and are never resolved against local beads.

TargetHashAllocator.description: Live Beads adaptive base36 hash policy, with ten nonce attempts per length through the configured maximum and monotonic parent.N child counters. Source IDs remain unchanged.

AuthzLinkAllowNotLast.message: authorization link allowed before the end of the chain

IdempotencyKeyReused.message: idempotency key reused with different parameters

OntologyUseSlotVerb.message: status transition requires its slot verb

LockoutRefused.message: change would lock out the applier

PluginHostWriteInSyncCall.message: plugin host write in synchronous call

InvalidCursor.message: cursor does not belong to this request

x-plugin-method-pattern.rule: Plugin methods are declared by the manifest under x.<alias>.*; each declares a permission and resource parameter. The dynamic set is not enumerated here.

x-contract-gaps: The design names authn.authenticate and authz.* as plugin-host calls; authn.authenticate and authz.verify are represented, while other hot-path calls remain host-internal.

Decisions #17/#18 select fixed project/team permissions and the bounded X1–X9 package; controller v2 authorizes implementation. This snapshot does not yet describe the complete X1–X9 contract and does not adopt Cedar. Historical failed latency evidence remains failed and is not runtime or performance acceptance for that package.

C7 dependency: admin.restore.begin.manifest remains an unrestricted object (type: object, additionalProperties: true), including in the stored method registry. The plug-dump/1 manifest schema and samples, paired version census, version refusal, store/head/lock metadata, checksum and verification declarations, and kind/secret rules are deferred to C7. This catalog cannot generate a typed restore manifest validator; C7 and typed restore consumers remain blocked until that contract is published and accepted.

x-method-registry.purpose: Human-maintained bounded contract artifact, read independently of methods at validation time; validates the closed method inventory, descriptor fields and wire inventories before an implementation generator exists.
x-method-registry.nameOrder: methods are compared in this order; the final item is followed by LF

validation.rule: Compare each registry method by name with exactly one OpenRPC method; reject a missing or duplicate name, descriptor mismatch, absent effect/permission/idempotency/stability/schema, unknown error reference, or duplicate error reference. The registry artifact is independently checked; it is not generated from the methods array at validation time.

x-method-registry.descriptorEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of methods in stored key and array order, ensure_ascii=false, no final newline; names use UTF-8 with LF after every name.

methodInventory.rule: Explicit JSON-RPC verbs in the source sections are expanded into named methods; entries called provisional remain marked in x-contract-gaps.

wireModel.goCodecRule: model.Op MarshalJSON and UnmarshalJSON emit and accept exactly the tagged flat operation schemas.

errorAllocation.rule: Values are append-only and never renumbered once published; the registry is the source of truth for new allocations.

reproduce: Run the self-contained validator in errors.md#bounded-registry-validation from the contracts directory.

generator.requiredGate: The registry artifact must validate the exact method inventory and descriptor parity before implementation PRs consume this snapshot; a future generator may replace it only with equivalent checks.

sourceRoot.note: The design inputs are intentionally untracked outside this contract worktree; this contract retains their digests. An implementation generator may later vendor the registry, but it must preserve this artifact's independent checks.

x-source-evidence.authorizationStatus: Decisions #17/#18 select fixed project/team permissions and the bounded X1–X9 package; controller v2 authorizes implementation. The post-stop parent/child contract conditionally supersedes #18's parented-create/reparent denial only for a future separately admitted implementation; project moves remain outside the contract. Decision #19 selects exact-head local Bazel checks plus independent review as the current merge gate. This snapshot retains historical source hashes and does not claim parented runtime support, complete X1–X9 acceptance, or performance acceptance.

operation.rule: Each ops item is exactly one tagged object from the ChangeSet oneOf; Go model.Op MarshalJSON/UnmarshalJSON uses this encoding.

ref.rule: Exactly one of id or key; branch is allowed only with id; no string shorthand.

event.rule: Durable events carry graph envelope fields; control events carry only typed details and never before/after. store.restored is a control boundary that carries fromIncarnation/toIncarnation details. dependency.conditionUnmet is the exact canonical spelling and requires closed ConditionUnmetDetails; ordinary durable events forbid details.

error.rule: Error data code is closed and named error components pin their code constant.

audit.rule: Optional Changeset.events is a typed complete ordered plan persisted with graph/version/log under the active lease. No-op/replay/rollback/dry-run add no event or revision. Current read authorization/redaction applies to every referenced resource, including raw changeset/history views. These API declarations alone do not implement emission or driver persistence.

x-cursor-contract.rule: The driver decodes and checks the tuple before reading; a token from another incarnation is never treated as a revision in the new incarnation.

x-display-name-contract.render: next to authenticated principal: user name, API key name, or anonymous; never replaces or impersonates the principal
x-display-name-contract.members: two sessions of the same principal remain separate members identified by sessionId; never merge labels into a trusted group identity
x-display-name-contract.refresh: There is no session-refresh method in this catalog. presence.set renews idle expiry without changing displayName.
x-display-name-contract.validation: The schema validates raw input type and normalized output length only. Trimming, empty-to-absent, rejection of Unicode Cc and Cf, and the input limit after trimming are normative consumer requirements; this contract PR does not implement or qualify them.
x-display-name-contract.consumerProof: After this contract lands, separately qualify real bound RPC normalization/refusal, storage/expiry/close/masking, principal and ownership separation, distinct sessions and UI rendering. Then rerun E3 with 50 distinct displayName values.

comment.verifiedActor: principal is the actual actor admitted for this restore; sourceAuthor is never an actor
comment.render: When a consumer exposes comments, render sourceAuthor beside the verified principal, like displayName; never replace the principal.
comment.compatibility: Legacy comments decode unchanged. Imported comments require origin import and sourceTime.

resultSurface.beadGet: bead.get retains its optional typed comments array when commentPage is omitted. When commentPage is selected, the result carries a pinned typed page instead of the unbounded array, with the same read authorization and as-of semantics.
resultSurface.consumerLimit: The comment page is a service/RPC projection; browser rendering and full B15 qualification require separate evidence.

ordinaryInputs.commentOp: closed to kind, target and body
ordinaryInputs.createPatchMetadata: ordinary create, patch, metadata and _meta inputs cannot select the trusted import actor or origin

trustedAdmission.authenticated: interactive user plus restore-admin authorization and operation/archive-bound D32
trustedAdmission.anonymousLocal: trusted human-presence admission with an honest anonymous actor/agent scope; do not promote an operator label to a verified user
trustedAdmission.failure: Missing or mismatched admission/profile refuses before staging and publishes no partial restore state.
trustedAdmission.scopeMapping: scope is the normalized G4 AgentLabel: empty for authenticated principals; anonymous-local preserves the admitted canonical anonymous agent label, including empty. Authenticated labels are ignored by G4 and are not a second scope.

allocator.source: Keep source IDs and sourceAllocator provenance exactly; never reinterpret source hash state as live target state.
allocator.target: Seed the source adaptive Beads hash policy and reconciled child counters through RestoreAllocators under allocator locks in the guarded restore transaction and replay.
allocator.childId: {parent}.{next positive decimal counter}; reconcile stored counters and observed direct children without changing source IDs
allocator.collision: Check every generated ID against all existing, source and staged IDs regardless of source width.
allocator.hashContinuation: Use source-configured min_hash_length, max_hash_length and max_collision_prob, with Beads defaults 3, 8 and 0.25 when absent; ten nonce attempts per length.
allocator.prefixBinding: targetAllocator.prefix must equal sourceAllocator.prefix; mismatch refuses before staging.
allocator.sourcePersistence: Persist sourceAllocator unchanged in the restore receipt and project metadata key plug.restore.sourceAllocator.

x-restore-import-contract.consumerProof: Contract/schema checks do not qualify host admission, converter round-trip, storage/recovery, or UI rendering; those owners must supply exact-head runtime evidence.
